units.source_text: 我帶上十塊錢，一個人走進銀座那家大型咖啡酒吧，

en.t: I took ten yen with me and went alone into that large cafe bar in Ginza,

units.source_text: 笑著對女服務員說：「我身上只有十塊錢，你看著辦吧。」

en.t: I smiled and said to the waitress, "I only have ten yen on me, so do what you can."

units.source_text: 「你不用擔心。」她的話帶有關西口音。

en.t: "You do not have to worry," she said, with a Kansai accent in her words.

units.source_text: 而且，這句話竟然奇妙地讓我怯弱戰慄的心平靜了下來。

en.t: And strangely enough, those words calmed my timid, trembling heart.

units.source_text: 不，這並不是因為我不用擔心錢的事，

en.t: No, it was not because I no longer had to worry about the money,

units.source_text: 而是因為我覺得待在她身邊感到安心。

en.t: but because I felt safe being beside her.

units.source_text: 因為對她很放心，我反而沒有心情扮演小丑去搞笑了，

en.t: Because I felt so at ease with her, I no longer felt like playing the clown to make jokes,

units.source_text: 只是不加掩飾地現出我沉默寡言和陰鬱的原形，默默地喝著酒。

en.t: and instead simply showed, without hiding it, my true silent and gloomy nature, drinking quietly.

units.source_text: 「這些吃的，有你喜歡的嗎？」女服務員把各種菜餚擺在我面前，問我。

en.t: "Is there anything here you like to eat?" the waitress asked, setting various dishes in front of me.
